com: Formal offer by means of scheme of arrangement announced at 590p per share plus 22 pence dividend. 99.9% of votes were in favour at meetings on 16 April 2026.

Recommended final cash offer by private equity firm EQT at £60 per share. The offer will be implemented by means of a Court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement and is expected to become effective in Q4 2026 or Q1 2027.
Scheme of arrangement made at same terms as indicative proposal. Beazley shareholder vote passed on 22 April 2026. Expected to become effective during H2 2026.
Shareholders have overwhelmingly approved the scheme. Completion expected on 20 August 2026 following the Court Sanction hearing on 19 August 2026.

Formal offer (scheme) announced on 7 April 2026 by Tinicum and Blackstone at 297.85p in cash. Overwhelmingly approved by shareholders on 26 May 2026. Indicative offer of 270p from Advent was rejected. Advent withdrew on 8 April 2026. Arcline Investment Management had made an approach before withdrawing on 1 April 2026.

Indicative offer by Toscafund (which already owns 24.36%) at 250p per share, with unlisted share alternative, which Board is "minded to recommend". Approaches had been previously received from Bridgepoint and Triton, following a strategic review but talks ended.

In preliminary discussions with a number of interested counterparties. Potential offerors not required to be identified, but Providence Equity Partners was named on 13 May 2026 (PUSU deadline 10 June). Epiris and separate Oakley Capital/Giacom consortium named on 15 May 2026 but Oakley Capital/Giacom withdrew on 12 June 2026. On 10 June 2026, Providence & Epiris formed a consortium with a PUSU deadline of 8 July 2026. On 24 June 2026, Providence announced that it was no longer part of the Consortium and Epiris was considering its options.

b: LONDONMETRIC PROPERTY & SCHRODER REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST
com: On 12 May 2026, LondonMetric and Schroder REIT made indicative all share offer, after strategic review. On 31 July 2026, LondonMetric and Schroder REIT announced a recommended all share offer (scheme) of 0.190 LondonMetric shares and 0.894 Schroder shares.

Helios consortium (which already owns 45.11%) has gone hostile, with 85p formal offer. StoneX had made an indicative offer of 110p, before withdrawing on 5 May, given the Helios Consortium's lack of support.

Multiple unsolicited proposals from Saudi Arabia's Alamadiyaf al-Masiyyah, which has due diligence access and a PUSU deadline of 29 July. Genel Energy plc made a recommended offer (scheme) on 2 July. Samos Energy made a higher indicative offer on 22 July 2026. Alamadiyaf al-Masiyyah and Samos Energy withdrew on 11 August 2026.
Strategic review - in discussions with two parties.
Strategic review & formal sale process. Has not received an indicative offer but has held preliminary discussions with a small number of counterparties.
Recommended cash offer (scheme) of 10.17p per share. The offer follows a proposal of 10.44p per share announced on 3 February 2026
Formal sale process. Discussions with potential bidders ongoing.
Discussions are with selected third parties as part of a private strategic review process.

Formal cash offer (scheme) from US ingredients group Ingredion Inc, valuing each share at up to 615p - 595p in cash plus permitted final and interim dividends of up to 20p. Follows proposal at same price.

On 12 June 2026, Glenstone REIT (which already owns 24%) announced an unsolicited offer at a price of 70p per share, rejected by target Board. On 6 July 2026, Glenstone announced a final cash offer of 71.4p per share with an acceptance condition of 50%, once again rejected by the Board. On 20 July 2026, the AIRE Board unanimously recommended the shareholders not to accept the Glenstone offer and to withdraw their acceptances as soon as possible.
AEWU considering an offer to acquire AIRE for 0.725 AEWU shares for each AIRE share. The offer follows discussions with AIRE Board earlier this year when an agreement could not be reached.
Recommended cash offer (scheme), with undertakings in relation to 0.34%. Follows previous approach by TA Associates, which withdrew on 18 May 2026

Apollo had emerged with a higher 715p/share cash possible offer vs Castlelake’s 690p. On 6 August 2026, Castlelake confirmed that it did not intend to make an offer for easyJet. On the same day, Apollo announced a recommended offer to be implemented by way of a scheme of arrangement together with an alternative offer of 1 rollover share for each easyJet share. Completion expected by the end of Q1 2027.
Recommended all share takeover offer. On 29 July 2026, Reabold announced that the acceptance period will run from 19 August 2026 to 25 September 2026.

On 23 June 2026, FirstCash announced a recommended cash offer of 600p per share plus dividends of up to 9p per share, to be effected by scheme of arrangement. On 16 July 2026, FirstCash announced a final recommended cash offer (scheme) for Ramsdens of 675p per share plus dividend of up to 9p per share. Scheme approved by shareholders on 10 August 2026.

Recommended cash offer (scheme) of 23.07p per share plus special dividend of 4p and ordinary dividend of 0.9317p per share. Following a competing bid announced by Serica Energy on 26 July 2026, the Board's recommendation was withdrawn. On 7 August 2026, Ratio announced an increased recommended cash offer (scheme) of 28.82p per share plus special dividend of 4p per share and ordinary dividend of 0.9317p per share. 41.76% undertakings. On 13 August 2026, Serica Energy withdrew its offer.
Following four proposals, the latest being at 1,031.7p per share (with a 25% partial cash alternative), Prologis launches a recommended offer to be effected by way of a scheme of arrangement.

On 10 July 2026, Brave Bison Group plc announced an unsolicited indicative proposal for the acquisition of the remaining 72% of System1 for 68p per share in cash and 2.7553 new Brave Bison shares. On 30 July 2026, Brave Bison announced a formal offer of 135p per share in cash and 2.04 Brave Bison shares and an alternative offer of 3.36 new Brave Bison shares for each System1 share. Acceptance threshold set at 50%. Both offers were rejected by the System1 Board.
Formal sale process. The Board is not in any active discussions with any potential offeror

Recommended cash offer (scheme) of 1,230p per share plus interim dividend of 4.9p per share for all shares G&H by  Greenlight Bidco Limited, an acquisition vehicle owned by Arlington Capital Partners VII, L.P.
Recommended cash offer (scheme) of 503p per share plus dividend of up to 3p per share for all shares in Rotork by ABB Automation Holding UK Limited, a subsidiary of ABB Ltd.

Recommended cash offer (scheme) for Mitie by OCS Group International Limited, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of OCS Group Topco Limited, of 218.5p per share and a final dividend of 3.1p per share.
Ridgeview Partners makes £545m indicative offer, with rollover alternative. 48.71% shareholders support and Board is minded to recommend the offer.

Indicative offer by CVC of 907.8p per share in cash plus an interim dividend of 7.2p per share. The Board would be minded to unanimously recommend the proposal, which follows earlier approaches from CVC, to Bodycote shareholders.

Indicative offer by Veritas of 906.8p per share in cash plus an interim dividend of 7.2p per share. The Board would be minded to unanimously recommend the proposal, which follows earlier approaches from Veritas, to Bodycote shareholders.

Unsolicited cash offer of 172.5p per share for the remaining 70.04% of the shares in Harworth not held by Peel Holdings, subject to a minimum acceptance threshold of 50%. The Harworth Board rejects the offer and believes it fundamentally undervalues Harworth and its near and longer-term prospects.
Indicative cash offer of 69p per share with a mixed cash and new DNO shares alternative.
